project.name: Cassandra + OpenSearch :: Distribution
project.description:
Assembles the tarball and the Docker image.
This is an aggregator rather than a single module for one reason: Maven mediates version conflicts across the whole dependency graph of a project, and Cassandra's tree and OpenSearch's tree conflict badly — Lucene 9.8 against 10.4, Netty 4.1 against 4.2, two Jackson lines, two zstd-jni. Resolving both in one POM would hand both isolated ClassLoaders the same mediated version and silently break at least one of them. Each lib directory is therefore resolved by its own module, in isolation, exactly as the runtime module that compiles against it does.
lib-cassandra -> the dse-db-all closure -> lib/cassandra/ lib-opensearch -> the OpenSearch closure -> lib/opensearch/
tarball -> lib/boot, conf, bin, data, logs, and the Docker image
